plan.title: bug(cursor): nested Task subagents cannot own Approach 1 review-monitors

narratives.Description: bug(cursor): nested Task subagents cannot own Approach 1 review-monitors
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

On Cursor, a `Task`-tool subagent cannot reliably spawn further `Task` subagents (nested Approach 1). Deft's review-cycle / swarm guidance still tells `drive-to: merge-ready` implementation workers to spawn a background review-monitor via the Cursor `Task` primitive. In practice the leaf either has no working nested `Task`, or it fakes ownership by backgrounding `task pr:watch` in a shell (`block_until_ms: 0`) and exiting — so `task verify:review-monitor -- --pr <N>` correctly reports no active monitor while the parent believes monitoring started.

This is a framework/process gap for Cursor Tier-1, not a one-off agent mistake.

## Observed (2026-07-23, deftai/directive #2790 / PR #2795)

1. Orchestrator dispatched a Cursor `Task` leaf (`leaf-implementation`, `drive-to: merge-ready`) with instructions to own PR + Greptile review-cycle.
2. After PR open, the leaf started `task pr:watch -- 2795` as a background shell and reported "review monitoring is active", then ended its turn.
3. Parent ran `task verify:review-monitor -- --pr 2795` → fail: Tier 1 available but no active review-monitor recorded (#2655).
4. Recovery that worked: **parent** (this chat) spawned a sibling review-monitor `Task` and ran `task review-monitor:register -- --pr 2795 --monitor-agent-id <id> --platform-primitive cursor-task`.

So Approach 1 is sound only when the agent that **has** `Task` does the spawn. Nesting "impl worker → monitor worker" on Cursor is the broken shape.

## Why this matters

- `#1880` Gap C / Gap D + `#1877` Cursor Tier-1 + `#2655` review-monitor gate assume a living Approach 1 poller.
- A leaf that exits after backgrounding a shell leaves no live agent to consume CLEAN / NEW_P0_P1, fix, or merge — exactly the "promise-to-poll evaporates" class `#1056` / `#2655` were meant to close.
- Operators see false "monitoring active" status and stalled PRs.

## Expected product shape

Document and enforce a Cursor-safe ownership split:

1. **Default (recommended):** Cursor `drive-to: merge-ready` leaves may implement + open PR, but **must not** claim Approach 1 by nesting `Task`. Either:
   - own a **blocking** `task pr:watch` in the same leaf turn/process (no nested spawn), or
   - `stop-at: pr-open` and hand back so the **orchestrator** spawns the sibling review-monitor `Task` + `review-monitor:register`.
2. **`verify:review-monitor`:** treat "I backgrounded a shell" as insufficient; registration remains the gate (#2655).
3. **Skills / preamble:** `deft-directive-review-cycle` + swarm Phase 3 + agent-prompt-preamble should explicitly forbid nested Cursor `Task` for review-monitors and describe the sibling-spawn / same-agent-blocking alternatives.
4. **Optional hardening:** if Cursor ever exposes nested `Task`, keep sibling-from-orchestrator as the documented default until nested spawn is proven in CI/eval.

## Non-goals

- Removing Cursor as Tier 1 (`Task` remains first-class for **parent→leaf** dispatch).
- Changing Greptile detection / `task pr:watch` semantics.
- Requiring Warp/`spawn_subagent` for Cursor sessions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Review-cycle + swarm Cursor docs state that nested `Task` (leaf spawning leaf) is unsupported / unreliable for Approach 1.
- [ ] `drive-to: merge-ready` Cursor envelopes prescribe either same-agent blocking `pr:watch` **or** `stop-at: pr-open` + orchestrator sibling monitor (with register).
- [ ] A regression note / eval trigger (or checklist item) covers "leaf claimed monitor active without `review-monitor:register`" as a fail.
- [ ] CHANGELOG / commands pointer updated so maintainers stop diagnosing this as random agent flakiness.

## Related

- #1877 — Cursor Task as Tier-1 review-monitor path
- #1880 — worker-owns-lifecycle / background dispatch
- #2655 — deterministic review-monitor gate
- #1056 — `task pr:watch` terminal verdict
- #2308 — review-cycle precedence over host babysit
- Stimulus: PR #2795 review ownership after #2790 swarm on Cursor (2026-07-23)

## Labels (suggested)

`bug`, `agent-experience`, `area:swarm`, `harness`
